subject: Purchase code certification, spend authority routing, and line-item rebind
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@onyxcloud.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@onyxcloud.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Purchase code issuance + line-item adjustments for initial onboarding

Hi Monica / David,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier this week. We're ready to move forward with the initial onboarding packet but have two items we need Redwood's assistance on before finance issues the PO:

1) Purchase code (PO) issuance tracking — our ERP needs a single purchase identifier assigned so we can reconcile against our contract. Can you confirm the expected PO number format and provide a short timeline for issuance?

2) Line-item corrections — the onboarding form we attached has three SKU lines that should be merged into a single subscription line (monthly compute + support). If those are combined, we also need spend cap guidance since our internal approvals differ from the amount on the form.

Attached: onboarding form (PDF) and a small CSV with the suggested line consolidation.

Can we get confirmation today if possible? We have a billing cutover scheduled next Tuesday.

Cheers,
Lara Chen
Procurement Lead, Onyx Cloud
procurement@onyxcloud.com

---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@onyxcloud.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purchase code issuance + line-item adjustments for initial onboarding

Hi Lara — thanks for the note and attachments. Short answers up front: yes, we can issue a purchase identifier and we can merge the three SKU lines into a single subscription line. I'll outline the plan below and loop finance for a spend-cap check.

Plan / next steps:
- PO identifier: Redwood issues a purchase code in the format RWI-ONYX-YYYYMMDD-XXXX. We can reserve the code today and publish the final PO number once the spend cap is confirmed.
- Line consolidation: we'll accept the consolidated subscription as described in your CSV. Please confirm the single description line and final monthly amount; we'll reflect that on the PO.
- Spend cap routing: marking Markus (Finance) for approval of a temporary spend guard (if needed) or confirmation that the onboarding amount falls within Onyx's standard spend band.
- Timeline: reserve code today (internal hold), finalize PO once Markus confirms spend cap (ETA 6–8 hours), issue formal PO PDF and HubSpot record link.

I've attached the onboarding form and the CSV you sent to this thread for record.

Monica Patel
Sr. Strategic Ops, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: onyx_onboard_form-20270521.pdf, lineitems-proposed-adjustments-onyx-20270521.csv

---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@onyxcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purchase code issuance + line-item adjustments for initial onboarding

Monica / team — quick finance note after a triage of the CSV and contract terms:

- Confirmed: The consolidated subscription line looks correct and maps to our onboarding SKU O-STD-MONTHLY.
- Spend cap: Onyx is eligible for a standard onboarding spend bracket up to $75,000 without exec sign-off. The consolidated amount on the CSV shows $64,200 (annualized), which is within that bracket. No additional approvals required.
- Temporary hold: I'll place a 48-hour provisional hold on the purchase code to allow legal to finalize the SOW language. The PO number can still be generated but will be marked "provisional" until SOW is attached.

I'll instruct Procurement Ops to generate RWI-ONYX-20270521-0007 as the provisional purchase identifier and will release as final when the signed SOW is uploaded to the HubSpot deal record. Monica — please confirm you want RWI-ONYX-20270521-0007 reserved.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
markus_klein@redwood.com

---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@onyxcloud.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purchase code issuance + line-item adjustments for initial onboarding

Thanks Markus — please reserve RWI-ONYX-20270521-0007 as provisional. Lara, confirming next steps on our side:

1) We have RWI-ONYX-20270521-0007 held as provisional.
2) Monica/David will update the HubSpot deal with the consolidated line and upload the signed SOW when available.
3) Once the SOW is uploaded, Markus will flip the PO from provisional to final and Procurement Ops will issue the official PO PDF.
4) For the interim billing cutover: if Onyx needs an invoice against the provisional PO for vendor setup, we can issue an onboarding invoice memo (not a final PO-backed invoice) — let us know if you require that.

Action items:
- Lara: confirm consolidated line description exactly as you want it to appear on the PO (one sentence).
- David: I'll need you to attach the SOW to the HubSpot record once countersigned.
- Markus: please confirm when the provisional hold is in place (ticket number if any).

Thanks — aiming to close this before your billing cutover next Tuesday.

Monica Patel
Sr. Strategic Ops, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
